entities.summary: Tim Minchin (b. 1975-10-07, Northampton) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Northampton and Australia. Known in the fields of australia, composers & musicians, oceania.
